name: Apptronik Series A-X
summary: $520M extension of the Series A, bringing the Series A total above $935M.
body: Apptronik named existing investors B Capital, Google, Mercedes-Benz and PEAK6 and new investors including AT&T Ventures. Valuation is left empty: Apptronik did not disclose it, and reports range from about $5B to over $5.5B.
